customer_id.meaning: Primary id of the customer profile (seed id or content hash); individuals, insurer accounts and fleet accounts all hold one profile.

name.meaning: Full legal name of the individual, or the registered company name of an insurer or fleet account, exactly as on file.

customer_type.meaning: Kind of profile: individual = a private vehicle owner; insurer = an insurance carrier account whose adjusters and claims staff call the desk; fleet = a commercial fleet account billed on its own terms.

phone_number.meaning: Primary phone number on the profile; for an insurer account, the claims desk number registered with the network.

email.meaning: Primary email address on the profile, lower case as registered.

postal_code.meaning: ZIP code of the mailing address on the profile (for an insurer or fleet account, of its registered business address).

account_pin.meaning: Four-digit account PIN the customer chose when the profile was opened; used only as an identity credential.

profile_opened_date.meaning: Date the profile was opened with the network.

vehicle_id.meaning: Primary id of the vehicle record.

customer_id.meaning: Owner of the vehicle on file (foreign key -> customers); the person or fleet the network repairs the vehicle for.

vin.meaning: Vehicle identification number as decoded at first visit.

model_year.meaning: Model year decoded from the VIN.

make.meaning: Manufacturer name as decoded from the VIN (e.g. Toyota).

model.meaning: Model name as decoded from the VIN (e.g. RAV4 XLE).

body_structure.meaning: Structural construction of the vehicle per the manufacturer body repair manual; aluminum_intensive and mixed_material require certified structural procedures for structural work.

powertrain.meaning: Powertrain decoded from the VIN; hybrid, plug_in_hybrid and battery_electric vehicles carry a high-voltage system.

adas_package.meaning: Driver-assistance sensors fitted at the factory as decoded from the VIN build data; determines which calibrations a repair can require.

registered_state.meaning: State in which the vehicle is registered; state law on parts disclosure and storage follows this state.

owned_through.meaning: Date the owner on file sold or otherwise disposed of the vehicle, as reported to the network; empty while the owner on file still owns it.

booking_id.meaning: Primary id of the estimate booking.

customer_id.meaning: Vehicle owner the booking is for (foreign key -> customers).

vehicle_id.meaning: Vehicle to be estimated (foreign key -> vehicles).

variant_name.meaning: Estimate type booked, written as its official name.

payer_type.meaning: Who is expected to pay for the repair: an insurer under a claim, or the customer.

insurer_customer_id.meaning: Insurer account profile (foreign key -> customers with customer_type insurer) for an insurance-claim booking; empty for customer pay.

insurer_claim_number.meaning: Claim number issued by the insurer, exactly as the insurer or customer states it; empty when not yet known or for customer pay.

booked_date.meaning: Date the booking request was made.

appointment_date.meaning: Current appointment date (for a Photo Estimate, the request date).

appointment_slot.meaning: Current appointment start time; empty for a Photo Estimate.

location_code.meaning: Repair center the booking is assigned to.

service_distance_miles.meaning: Road distance between the assigned center and the vehicle's location at booking.

structural_damage.meaning: Whether structural damage is reported at booking, then as confirmed on the written estimate.

drivable.meaning: Whether the vehicle can be driven safely, as reported at booking.

airbag_deployed.meaning: Whether any airbag deployed in the loss, as reported at booking.

high_voltage_damage.meaning: Whether damage is near the high-voltage battery or cabling of a hybrid or electric vehicle, as reported at booking.

checked_in_date.meaning: Date the visit was checked in; empty until then.

estimate_written_date.meaning: Date the written estimate was completed; empty until then. Validity, revision and credit windows count from it.

estimate_total_usd.meaning: Current estimate total (parts, labor, materials, sublet) before any deductible; replaced by each revision.

estimated_labor_hours.meaning: Current total labor hours on the estimate; replaced by each revision.

converted_date.meaning: Date the repair order was opened from this booking; empty unless converted.

vehicle_released_date.meaning: Date a vehicle left at the center for a teardown estimate was released unrepaired; empty while it remains or when not applicable.

closed_date.meaning: Date the booking reached cancelled, no_show, declined or expired; empty otherwise.

estimate_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the booking event.

booking_id.meaning: Booking the event belongs to (foreign key -> estimate_bookings).

customer_id.meaning: Customer of the booking (foreign key -> customers).

event_type.meaning: Event family, taken verbatim from the declared event types.

reschedule_number.meaning: Ordinal of a reschedule on the booking; empty for other events.

revision_number.meaning: Ordinal of an estimate revision on the booking; empty for other events.

fee_type.meaning: Kind of estimate-stage charge; empty for non-charge events.

amount_usd.meaning: Charge, payment or waiver amount; always positive, the event type gives the direction.

period_start_date.meaning: First billed day of a storage charge; empty otherwise.

period_end_date.meaning: Last billed day of a storage charge (inclusive); empty otherwise.

tow_miles.meaning: Tow distance on a tow_in charge; 0 otherwise.

charge_event_id.meaning: The estimate_fee_charge row a payment or waiver applies to; empty for other events.

payment_method.meaning: How a payment was made; empty for other events.

waiver_reason.meaning: Reason for a waiver; empty for other events.

request_id.meaning: Primary id of the customer request awaiting confirmation.

customer_id.meaning: Customer who must confirm (foreign key -> customers).

booking_id.meaning: Booking the request concerns (foreign key -> estimate_bookings).

request_type.meaning: teardown_authorization = permission to disassemble the vehicle for a teardown estimate; decline_repair = the customer's decision not to repair on this estimate.

request_status.meaning: pending_customer until the customer confirms; confirmed once they do; withdrawn if they retract it before confirming.

requested_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()
requested_at.meaning: Moment the desk registered the request.

confirmed_date.meaning: Date the customer confirmed; empty until confirmed.

claim_repair_id.meaning: Primary id of the insurance claim repair order.

booking_id.meaning: Estimate booking the repair order was converted from (foreign key -> estimate_bookings); empty for a direct insurer assignment.

insurer_customer_id.meaning: Insurer account paying the claim (foreign key -> customers with customer_type insurer).

carrier_agreement_id.meaning: The insurer's program agreement the repair is handled under (foreign key -> carrier_agreements); empty when the insurer has none.

insurer_claim_number.meaning: Claim number issued by the insurer, exactly as issued.

coverage_type.meaning: Coverage the claim is paid under, as stated by the insurer; third_party_liability is another driver's insurer paying, with no deductible.

variant_name.meaning: Repair class assigned at opening, as its official name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the repair order.

deductible_usd.meaning: Policy deductible for this claim exactly as stated by the insurer; 0.00 for third_party_liability.

original_estimate_usd.meaning: Estimate total submitted for the original authorization, before deductible and betterment.

estimated_labor_hours.meaning: Labor hours on the estimate submitted for authorization.

estimated_repair_days.meaning: Planned repair days computed at authorization (production days rounded up plus intake and delivery days); empty before authorization.

opened_date.meaning: Date the repair order was opened.

authorized_date.meaning: Date the insurer's authorization was recorded; empty before.

repair_started_date.meaning: Drop-off date on which production started; empty before.

hold_reason.meaning: Why the repair order is on hold; empty when not on hold.

completed_date.meaning: Vehicle-ready date (final inspection passed and notice sent); empty before.

delivered_date.meaning: Date the vehicle was released to the customer; empty before.

total_loss_date.meaning: Date the insurer's total-loss determination was received; empty unless total loss.

closed_date.meaning: Date the repair order was closed or withdrawn; empty while open.

supplement_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the supplement event.

claim_repair_id.meaning: Repair order the supplement belongs to (foreign key -> claim_repairs).

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the declared event types.

supplement_number.meaning: Ordinal of the supplement on the repair order; the submission and its decision share it.

submission_event_id.meaning: On a decision, the claim_supplement_submit row decided; empty on a submission.

supplement_amount_usd.meaning: Gross amount of the supplement as submitted.

includes_structural.meaning: Whether the supplement adds structural operations.

includes_calibration.meaning: Whether the supplement adds sensor calibrations.

approval_route.meaning: Route the supplement takes, fixed at submission.

decision.meaning: Insurer's (or, when self-approved, the center's) decision; empty on a submission.

approved_amount_usd.meaning: Amount approved on a decision; 0.00 when denied; empty on a submission.

betterment_usd.meaning: Betterment on wear parts within the supplement (expected on a submission, applied on a decision).

ledger_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the ledger entry.

claim_repair_id.meaning: Repair order the entry belongs to (foreign key -> claim_repairs).

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the declared event types.

approval_type.meaning: Kind of insurer approval; empty for other entries.

supplement_number.meaning: Supplement an approval or charge arises from; 0 when not supplement-related.

charge_type.meaning: Kind of customer charge (also carried on the mirroring insurer offset); empty for other entries.

amount_usd.meaning: Entry amount, always positive; the event type gives the account and direction.

betterment_usd.meaning: Betterment the insurer applied within an approval; 0.00 when none; empty on other entries.

period_start_date.meaning: First billed day of a storage charge; empty otherwise.

period_end_date.meaning: Last billed day of a storage charge (inclusive); empty otherwise.

consent_id.meaning: Signed consent a customer-pay charge rests on (foreign key -> claim_consents); empty otherwise.

source_entry_id.meaning: Ledger entry an offset, refund, credit or adjustment refers to; empty otherwise.

payment_method.meaning: Method of a customer payment or refund; empty otherwise.

payment_reference.meaning: Insurer check or EFT reference on an insurer payment, exactly as remitted; empty otherwise.

credit_reason.meaning: Reason for a customer credit; empty otherwise.

adjustment_reason.meaning: Reason for an insurer adjustment; empty otherwise.

consent_id.meaning: Primary id of the consent awaiting or bearing the customer's signature.

claim_repair_id.meaning: Repair order the consent concerns (foreign key -> claim_repairs).

consent_type.meaning: repair_authorization = permission to repair; direction_to_pay = instruction that the insurer pay the network directly; non_oem_parts_disclosure = acknowledgement of non-original parts on the insurer's estimate; customer_pay_addition = agreement to pay for an added item; vehicle_withdrawal = decision to take the vehicle away unrepaired.

consent_status.meaning: pending_customer until signed; signed once the customer signs; revoked if withdrawn before signing or, for customer_pay_addition, before the work starts.

amount_usd.meaning: Amount the customer agrees to pay on a customer_pay_addition; 0.00 for other consent types.

labor_hours.meaning: Labor hours of the added work on a customer_pay_addition; 0.0 otherwise.

addition_kind.meaning: What a customer_pay_addition covers; not_applicable for other consent types.

requested_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()
requested_at.meaning: Moment the desk issued the consent for signature.

signed_date.meaning: Date the customer signed; empty until signed.

retail_repair_id.meaning: Primary id of the customer-pay repair order.

customer_id.meaning: Customer paying for the work (foreign key -> customers).

booking_id.meaning: Estimate booking converted into this repair order (foreign key -> estimate_bookings).

variant_name.meaning: Service tier, as its official name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the repair order.

quoted_total_usd.meaning: Quoted total before any discount (labor, refinish, materials, supplies, fees, parts).

quoted_labor_usd.meaning: Labor portion of the quote (body and refinish labor).

dent_count.meaning: Dents quoted on a Paintless Dent Repair Service; 0 otherwise.

discount_program.meaning: Single discount program applied, fixed at opening.

retail_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the ledger entry.

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the declared event types.

charge_type.meaning: Kind of charge; empty for other entries.

amount_usd.meaning: Entry amount, always positive; the event type gives the direction.

approval_id.meaning: Approved additional-work request charged (foreign key -> retail_approvals); empty otherwise.

parts_event_id.meaning: Parts order a restocking or non-returnable charge arises from (foreign key -> retail_parts); empty otherwise.

period_start_date.meaning: First billed storage day; empty otherwise.

period_end_date.meaning: Last billed storage day (inclusive); empty otherwise.

source_entry_id.meaning: Entry a credit or refund refers to; empty otherwise.

credit_reason.meaning: Reason for a credit; empty otherwise.

payment_method.meaning: Method of a payment or refund; empty otherwise.

parts_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the parts event.

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the declared event types.

parts_order_number.format: supplier order number, letters and digits
parts_order_number.meaning: Supplier's order number on an order; empty on a return.

parts_amount_usd.meaning: Parts amount as quoted to the customer.

parts_returnable.meaning: Whether the supplier accepts the parts back (false for special-order and painted parts).

source_parts_event_id.meaning: On a return, the retail_parts_order row returned; empty on an order.

approval_id.meaning: Primary id of the request awaiting the customer's decision.

approval_type.meaning: additional_work = an item beyond the quote; cancellation = stopping the job.

amount_usd.meaning: Price of the additional item; 0.00 for a cancellation.

labor_hours.meaning: Labor hours of the additional item; 0.0 for a cancellation.

approval_status.meaning: pending_customer until answered; approved or declined by the customer; lapsed when the response window passed unanswered.

requested_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()
requested_at.meaning: Moment the desk issued the request.

decided_date.meaning: Date answered or lapsed; empty while pending.

glass_job_id.meaning: Primary id of the glass job.

variant_name.meaning: Glass service, as its official name.

payer_type.meaning: Who pays: an insurer's glass program, the customer, or a fleet account on terms.

insurer_customer_id.meaning: Insurer account for a glass claim (foreign key -> customers); empty otherwise.

insurer_claim_number.meaning: Insurer glass claim or referral number, exactly as issued; empty otherwise.

full_glass_coverage.meaning: Whether the insurer states the policy carries full glass coverage (no glass deductible); false for non-insurance jobs.

deductible_usd.meaning: Glass deductible stated by the insurer; 0.00 for non-insurance jobs.

glass_part_type.meaning: Glass installed: original-equipment or aftermarket; none for a chip repair.

glass_part_price_usd.meaning: Network price list amount of the glass part installed; 0.00 for a chip repair.

chip_count.meaning: Chips to repair on a chip repair; 0 otherwise.

appointment_slot.meaning: Current appointment start (start of the arrival window for mobile).

installed_date.meaning: Date replacement glass was bonded; empty otherwise.

installed_time.meaning: Time the glass was set, starting the safe drive-away clock; empty otherwise.

calibration_required.meaning: Whether the installed windshield carries a camera bracket needing calibration, as confirmed at installation.

closed_date.meaning: Date the job ended as cancelled, missed or not_repairable; empty otherwise.

glass_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the job event.

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the declared event types.

reschedule_number.meaning: Ordinal of the reschedule on the job.

glass_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the ledger entry.

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the declared event types.

charge_type.meaning: Kind of customer charge; empty otherwise.

amount_usd.meaning: Entry amount, always positive; the event type gives the direction.

payment_method.meaning: Method of a customer payment; empty otherwise.

source_entry_id.meaning: Entry a credit or adjustment refers to; empty otherwise.

credit_reason.meaning: Reason for a customer credit; empty otherwise.

warranty_coverage_id.meaning: Chip Repair Guarantee coverage behind a chip_repair_credit (foreign key -> warranty_coverages); empty otherwise.

billing_kind.meaning: Whether an insurer billing is the original or a corrected one; empty otherwise.

payment_reference.meaning: Insurer remittance reference, exactly as remitted; empty otherwise.

adjustment_reason.meaning: Reason for an insurer adjustment; empty otherwise.

adas_order_id.meaning: Primary id of the calibration order.

variant_name.meaning: Calibration tier, as its official name.

glass_job_id.meaning: Source glass job (foreign key -> glass_jobs); empty for other sources.

claim_repair_id.meaning: Source insurance claim repair order (foreign key -> claim_repairs); empty for other sources.

retail_repair_id.meaning: Source customer-pay repair order (foreign key -> retail_repairs); empty for other sources.

warranty_event_id.meaning: Source warranty rework authorization (foreign key -> warranty_events); empty for other sources.

payer_type.meaning: Who pays the calibration, fixed at opening.

systems_to_calibrate.meaning: System or systems the order calibrates.

oem_procedure.meaning: Procedure the manufacturer's repair information specifies for the forward camera on this vehicle; not_applicable when no camera is on the order.

included_in_original_estimate.meaning: Whether the calibration was on the original estimate the insurer authorized (insurance claim repairs only; false otherwise).

precheck_date.meaning: Date the precheck passed; empty before.

sublet_date.meaning: Date the vehicle went to the dealer; empty unless sublet.

sublet_dealer.meaning: Name of the franchised dealer performing a sublet, as on its invoice; empty unless sublet.

dealer_invoice_usd.meaning: Dealer invoice for a sublet; 0.00 for in-house completion.

cancel_reason.meaning: Why a cancelled order was cancelled; empty otherwise.

closed_date.meaning: Date the order was declined or cancelled; empty otherwise.

adas_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the order event.

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the declared event types.

check_number.meaning: Ordinal of an alignment check on the order; empty otherwise.

alignment_result.meaning: Result of an alignment check; empty otherwise.

alignment_corrected.meaning: Whether an out-of-spec alignment was corrected in the same visit; false when in spec.

attempt_number.meaning: Ordinal of a calibration attempt on the order; a dual-procedure attempt records one row per procedure under the same number.

attempt_result.meaning: Outcome of an attempt; empty otherwise.

failure_code.meaning: Why an attempt failed; none when passed.

adas_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the ledger entry.

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the declared event types.

amount_usd.meaning: Entry amount, always positive; the event type gives the direction.

source_entry_id.meaning: Charge a transfer or write-off refers to; empty otherwise.

claim_repair_id.meaning: Repair order a transfer is billed through (foreign key -> claim_repairs); empty otherwise.

supplement_number.meaning: Supplement on that repair order approving the calibration; 0 when on the original estimate.

payer_kind.meaning: Who made a payment; empty otherwise.

payment_method.meaning: Method of a payment; empty otherwise.

payment_reference.meaning: Glass program remittance reference, exactly as remitted; empty otherwise.

no_charge_reason.meaning: Reason for a write-off; empty otherwise.

declination_id.meaning: Primary id of the declination form.

declination_status.meaning: pending_customer until signed; signed once signed; withdrawn if retracted before signing.

requested_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now()
requested_at.meaning: Moment the desk issued the form.

rental_reservation_id.meaning: Primary id of the rental reservation.

vehicle_id.meaning: Customer's vehicle in repair (foreign key -> vehicles).

variant_name.meaning: Rental class currently reserved or rented, as its official name.

coverage_source.meaning: Who pays the covered days: the customer's own rental coverage, another driver's insurer, nobody (customer pays all), or the network under a warranty.

claim_repair_id.meaning: Insurance claim repair order the rental is for (foreign key -> claim_repairs); empty otherwise.

retail_repair_id.meaning: Customer-pay repair order the rental is for (foreign key -> retail_repairs); empty otherwise.

warranty_coverage_id.meaning: Warranty coverage a courtesy rental rests on (foreign key -> warranty_coverages); empty otherwise.

insurer_customer_id.meaning: Insurer paying covered days (foreign key -> customers); empty otherwise.

daily_coverage_cap_usd.meaning: Insurer's daily rental cap on first-party coverage as stated by the insurer; 0.00 when no cap applies.

coverage_max_usd.meaning: Insurer's total rental limit for the claim as stated by the insurer; 0.00 when no limit applies.

renter_age.meaning: Renter's age at pickup, as stated by the renter and checked at the counter.

branch_code.format: partner branch code, 3 letters and 3 digits (e.g. DEN214)

pickup_time.meaning: Pickup time, from which rental days are counted; empty before pickup.

coverage_end_date.meaning: Last calendar day on which a starting rental day is covered; empty for customer_pay.

return_time.meaning: Return time as counted (after-hours returns at branch opening); empty before return.

rental_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the reservation event.

claim_repair_id.meaning: Insurance claim repair order reporting the notice (foreign key -> claim_repairs); empty otherwise.

retail_repair_id.meaning: Customer-pay repair order reporting the notice (foreign key -> retail_repairs); empty otherwise.

rental_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the ledger entry.

event_type.meaning: Event family, verbatim from the declared event types.

authorization_number.meaning: Ordinal of an authorization on the reservation; empty otherwise.

authorization_reason.meaning: Why days were authorized; empty otherwise.

extension_request_id.meaning: Extension request an authorization approves (foreign key -> rental_extension_requests); empty otherwise.

paid_by.meaning: Who pays authorized or billed days; empty otherwise.

days_count.meaning: Days authorized, consumed, billed or charged by the entry; 0 for flat charges.

extension_request_id.meaning: Primary id of the extension request.

insurer_customer_id.meaning: Insurer asked to approve (foreign key -> customers).
